input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind swept pale lilac hood, ivory layered cloth with two narrow trailing lilac panels, silver wire charms and belt tools, slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Sparse wind wisps and tiny branching lightning. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate complete poses of ONE SAME character. Read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: four keys of a QUICK FLINCH AND RECOVERY: 1 ready upright pose; 2 sharp unmistakable recoil with shoulders and head pulled BACK by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; 3 shoulders returning and braced bent legs; 4 upright recovered ready pose. These four poses MUST visibly differ, not four standing duplicates. Row 2: first four keys of a BIGGER STAGGER: 5 upright ready; 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; 7 deepest backward bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; 8 lower body catches the weight, bent knees or legs. Row 3: 9 pushing back upright, visibly struggling; 10 upright recovered. Then begin COLLAPSE: 11 ready upright; 12 legs buckle and body drops. Row 4: continue COLLAPSE: 13 body very low, leaning toward ground; 14 torso falls sideways nearly horizontal; 15 body settles FULLY LYING on its side, head and entire torso on ground; 16 body completely still FULLY LYING ON GROUND, legs extended or naturally folded, equipment resting beside it. The final TWO poses must be completely horizontal resting bodies, never crouching, kneeling, sitting or getting back up. Treat collapse as a harmless theatrical fall/rest pose, fully intact. No blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. No attacker, impact flash or effects. Each of the 16 equal cells contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 65% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. CORRECTION: Rear-facing all the way: back of head, back cloak and spine face camera. Collapse FORWARD AWAY, face DOWN and HIDDEN in both final lying keys. The entire body AND staff fit in middle 60% of each cell, especially the bottom row. No clipped feet or weapons. Strong 25 degree torso flinch in key 2.

arguments.Prompt:
Original painted game character ANIMATION SPRITESHEET on solid uniform vivid pure MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Reference-1.png defines the exact character identity, costume, and equipment: lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind a swept pale lilac hood, layered ivory cloth tunic/robes with two narrow trailing lilac cloth panels, belt with silver wire charms and tools, holding a slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Reference-2.png is painting style reference only (sculpted painterly digital dark fantasy, smooth opaque brushwork, confident broken contours, subtle silver highlights, no grain or 3D render).

CAMERA & PERSPECTIVE:
Elevated 55-degree orthographic view. For ALL poses, the camera sees REAR surfaces: REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, back of head, spine, and back cloak facing camera, head and torso facing diagonally away from viewer toward upper-right. Maintain this rear anatomical view throughout every pose.

GRID LAYOUT:
Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows (16 equal cells total), showing 16 consecutive animation keyframes of the exact same character at identical anatomical scale, read left to right, top to bottom.
Wide empty pure magenta gutters separating cells. Every pose and the staff fits comfortably within the middle 60% of its cell, never touching cell boundaries or clipping. No cell borders, no grid lines, no text, no labels, no floor, no shadows, no ground plane, no effects or impact flashes.

POSE BREAKDOWN:
- Row 1 (Quick Flinch & Recovery):
  Cell 1: Ready upright rear-right stance.
  Cell 2: Sharp flinch recoil, shoulders and head pulled back by one head-width, torso visibly arched/bent back 25 degrees away from impact.
  Cell 3: Shoulders returning forward, legs bent and braced to absorb momentum.
  Cell 4: Upright recovered ready stance.
- Row 2 (Bigger Stagger):
  Cell 5: Upright ready stance.
  Cell 6: Abrupt backward bend of upper torso.
  Cell 7: Deepest backward stagger bend, arms pulled inward, balance visibly broken.
  Cell 8: Lower body catches weight with deeply bent knees/legs.
- Row 3 (Struggle Recovery & Collapse Start):
  Cell 9: Pushing back upright, visibly struggling against weight.
  Cell 10: Upright recovered stance.
  Cell 11: Ready upright stance before collapse.
  Cell 12: Legs buckle, knees give out, body drops downward.
- Row 4 (Collapse & Resting Body):
  Cell 13: Body very low, leaning forward-down toward ground.
  Cell 14: Torso falling forward-away nearly horizontal.
  Cell 15: Body settles FULLY LYING DOWN flat on ground, falling forward away from camera, face down and hidden, back of torso uppermost.
  Cell 16: Completely still FULLY LYING DOWN resting pose flat on ground, face down and hidden, spine/back facing up, staff resting beside body. Cells 15 and 16 must be completely horizontal resting poses, face hidden. Fully intact, theatrical rest, no blood or injury.

ART STYLE:
Hand-painted dark fantasy character art, rich physical volume, smooth opaque paint, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth, shared cool upper-left lighting. No heavy cartoon outlines, no 3D render look. High contrast against vivid magenta #FF00FF.
